obligations.statement: Hold the monitor arm fixed relative to the desk edge against external loads.
Accommodate desk edge thicknesses in the range 18 to 40 mm.
Prevent relative movement between product and desk edge along the edge once tightened.
Prevent angular movement (rotation) of the product relative to the desk edge under the arm's load.
Allow reversible removal from the desk edge and reattachment elsewhere.
Enable fixing and removal without tools, operated by the user.
Provide a mechanism to span the stated thickness range.
Create sufficient friction or mechanical interference to resist slipping and rotating once tightened.
Provide a user-operable release mechanism that leaves the product reusable.

obligations_created.statement: Provide a threaded spindle engaging with a nut to convert rotation into clamping force.
Provide a cam profile that locks over-centre to hold the clamp tight.
Provide a linkage that goes over-centre to lock the clamp.

acceptance_contracts.criterion: The product must provide a clamping force that holds the arm in place against the applied load without separation.
acceptance_contracts.proof_required: Calculate that the clamp force exceeds the applied load with a safety factor.

acceptance_contracts.criterion: The product must fit desk edges with thickness ranging from 18 to 40 mm inclusive.
acceptance_contracts.proof_required: Show that the adjustable range encompasses the stated interval.

acceptance_contracts.criterion: The product must not slip along the edge after tightening.
acceptance_contracts.proof_required: Show that the friction or mechanical lock resists the applied shear load.

acceptance_contracts.criterion: The product must not rotate under the arm's load.
acceptance_contracts.proof_required: Show that the clamp resists the applied moment.

acceptance_contracts.criterion: The product must be removable without damage and be reusable.
acceptance_contracts.proof_required: Demonstrate that the release mechanism can be operated and reassembled.

acceptance_contracts.criterion: The product must be fixable and removable without tools.
acceptance_contracts.proof_required: Show that all operations are hand-operated and require no external tools.

unresolved.statement: The required clamping force and resistance to slip/rotation cannot be quantified without knowing the arm's mass and geometry.
The definition of 'tight' and who judges it is unspecified, affecting acceptance of the non-slip requirement.
The desk edge material and finish are unknown, affecting friction and potential damage.
It is unclear whether 'without any tools' applies to removal as well as fixing.
The available overhang behind the desk edge is unknown, affecting the reach of the fixing.

assumptions: The desk edge is a solid, stationary surface capable of withstanding the clamping force.
The monitor arm is a rigid body that applies a static load (weight and moment) at its attachment point.
The clamping mechanism will rely on friction and/or mechanical interference to resist slipping and rotation.
The product will be made of a rigid material with sufficient strength and stiffness (materials unspecified).
The user has sufficient manual dexterity and strength to operate the mechanism without tools.
The environment includes gravity and the arm's load; other environmental factors are negligible.
The mounting surface of the desk edge is flat and parallel to the clamping surfaces.
The product will be installed and removed by a single adult user.
The range of edge thicknesses is inclusive, i.e., 18 mm and 40 mm are both accommodated.
